value.behaviour: Render the unread notifications home-page card content with live signal refresh, polling fallback, deep-linking to /notifications?id=<id>, and per-item mark-as-read.
rules: 1. Export /** @public */ type HomePageUnreadNotificationsProps = { limit?: number; pollingIntervalMs?: number } and export const Content = (props: HomePageUnreadNotificationsProps) => JSX.Element with defaults limit = 5 and pollingIntervalMs = 10000.

2. Use useTranslationRef(notificationsTranslationRef) from '@backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha', useApi(notificationsApiRef) and useApiHolder() from '@backstage/core-plugin-api' (resolving const toastApi = apiHolder.get(toastApiRef) with toastApiRef from '@backstage/frontend-plugin-api'), and resolve let notificationsRoute = '/notifications' via try { notificationsRoute = useRouteRef(rootRouteRef)(); } catch {} (with // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/rules-of-hooks).

3. Fetch unread notifications via useNotificationsApi(api => api.getNotifications({ read: false, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc', limit }), [limit]) from '../../hooks', sync value?.notifications into local useState<Notification[]>([]) in a useEffect([value]), and store retry in a ref (retryRef.current = retry) alongside an isMountedRef cleaned up on unmount.

4. Subscribe to 'notifications' signals with const { lastSignal, isSignalsAvailable } = useSignal<NotificationSignal>('notifications') from '@backstage/plugin-signals-react'; in a useEffect([isSignalsAvailable, lastSignal]), when isSignalsAvailable && lastSignal is truthy, call retryRef.current(); in a useEffect([isSignalsAvailable, pollingIntervalMs]), when !isSignalsAvailable && pollingIntervalMs > 0, start const timer = setInterval(() => { retryRef.current(); }, pollingIntervalMs) and return () => clearInterval(timer).

5. Render <Progress /> when loading && !value; render <ResponseErrorPanel error={error} /> when error is defined; render <Text variant="body-medium" color="secondary">{t('homePageCard.emptyMessage')}</Text> when notifications.length === 0.

6. For each notification in notifications, render a row (<Flex key={notification.id} justify="between" align="center" gap="3">) containing <SeverityIcon severity={notification.payload.severity} />, <Link to={`${notificationsRoute}?id=${encodeURIComponent(notification.id)}`}>{notification.payload.title}</Link>, optional <Text variant="body-small" color="secondary">{notification.payload.description}</Text>, optional metadata (notification.origin, notification.payload.topic, and <RelativeTime value={notification.created} /> with // @ts-ignore before import RelativeTime from 'react-relative-time'), and a <ButtonIcon aria-label={t('homePageCard.markAsRead')} icon={<RiCheckboxCircleLine size={16} />} variant="secondary" onPress={() => handleMarkAsRead(notification.id)} /> that awaits notificationsApi.updateNotifications({ ids: [id], read: true }), removes the item from notifications state on success if still mounted, and calls toastApi?.post({ title: t('homePageCard.errors.markAsReadFailed'), status: 'danger' }) on error.
